title: Cohabitation Is Replacing Marriage Across Generations
hook: The youngest adults now cohabit more often than they marry.
closing: Living together has moved from a young-adult alternative to a broader generational shift.
question: Would you live together before marriage?

segments.say: Among the youngest adults, 9% live with an unmarried partner. Cohabitation now exceeds marriage for that group.
Spousal living among adults aged 25 to 34 fell to 40%. Cohabitation grew as early marriage retreated.
More than 4.2 million older adults now cohabit. The shift has spread beyond the youngest couples.
